title: Payroll diversion in practice
intro: Bank details never change by email. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Updating my salary account
decisions.prompt: Look at the sender's domain. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Updating my salary account
body: Please pay the September salary into this account: AZ00ULDZ00000000000000007731
I will bring the form later. Kamran Aliyev, Transport Unit

decisions.explain: The domain is not your office's domain, it has an extra word added.

decisions.title: Searching for the HR portal
decisions.prompt: You search for Kadr Kabineti to check your payslip. What do you do?

artifact.title: Search: kadr kabineti
body: Ad · kadr-kabineti-giris.example.net: Kadr Kabineti, official payslip sign-in

decisions.explain: The ad leads to a fake portal. A bookmark always takes you to the real address.

decisions.title: New request: bank detail change, Ayten Huseynova
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: New request: bank detail change, Ayten Huseynova
body: The employee sent this request in Kadr Kabineti, signed in with two-step verification.
Review the request in the system:

decisions.explain: The address is your office's own domain and the request came from inside the system.

decisions.title: Message from SahilBank

artifact.name: SahilBank
body: Salary of 1,240.00 AZN credited to your card. Balance: 1,386.50 AZN.

decisions.explain: There is no link and it asks for nothing. This is a normal information message.

decisions.title: Message from Sabina Aliyeva, manager

artifact.name: Sabina Aliyeva, manager
body: I am in a meeting and cannot call. Quickly buy five 100 manat BonusMarket cards and send me the codes here. I will pay you back.

decisions.explain: A gift card code is like cash and never comes back. Call your manager on a number you know to check.
